message: "/docs" is also matched by the Prefix path "/" on this host. ingress-nginx may answer "/docs" with a 301 redirect to "/docs/" or route it to the broader path; a Gateway will route it to the broader path. Confirm which you rely on.
ingress-nginx answers "/my-path" with a 301 redirect to "/my-path/". Without an explicit redirect the Gateway returns 404 for "/my-path".

fix.summary: Add a rule that redirects the slashless path.
fix.snippet:
- matches:
  - path:
      type: Exact
      value: "/my-path"
  filters:
  - type: RequestRedirect
    requestRedirect:
      statusCode: 301
      path:
        type: ReplaceFullPath
        replaceFullPath: "/my-path/"
